uncited: **Stretching:** For each tilt view $y(\theta, \cdot, \cdot)$, stretch the image in the direction perpendicular to the tilt axis by a factor of $\sec(\theta)$.
The image size $(n_h \times n_w)$ is preserved.
*   **Tilt Axis Orientation:** The formula $y_{\text{stretched}}(\theta, i, j) = y(\theta, i, j \sec \theta)$ assumes the tilt axis is parallel to the $\hat{y}$ axis (stretching along $\hat{x}$).
*   **Limited Angle:** The method is designed for limited-angle tomography where $\theta < 90^\circ$.
